verdict.rationale: Better Stack's status page product explicitly supports custom subdomains/branding, custom CSS, email subscriber notifications, password protection/SSO for private pages, and is driven from monitor/incident state (HTTP monitors auto-create incidents reflected on the page). This covers hosting, custom domain, subscriber notifications, and incident-driven state directly per docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and no explicit mention of automatic custom SSL/domain verification flow details.
